name: Notion
description: Notion API for reading and writing pages, databases, comments and users in workspaces.
auth_notes: Internal connection tokens and personal access tokens are sent as Authorization Bearer headers; public or scoped integrations use OAuth 2.0.
gate_detail: Tokens and OAuth integrations are created in the Developer portal; a free Notion plan exists. The Admin API is Enterprise-only and some agent features are in private beta.
api_scope: REST API for pages, databases, comments, content queries and users, with an official JavaScript SDK and the ntn CLI.
mcp_notes: Notion's own developer docs include a Notion MCP section; no URL is given in the sources.
blocker_detail: Admin API requires Enterprise plan; other endpoints need only a workspace and an integration or token.

evidence.quote: Personal access tokens (PATs) are created directly by a Notion user in the Developer portal.
Navigate to the Developer portal and create a new OAuth integration.
The admin API lets organization owners on the Enterprise Plan run admin work with code.

issues: MCP server URL and official status are inferred from a Notion MCP docs section, not stated outright.
Webhooks inferred from a Webhook events docs section.
